plain_definition: Hong Kong's law requiring anyone who issues a fiat-referenced stablecoin in Hong Kong, or pegged to the Hong Kong dollar, to hold a licence from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. It has been in force since 1 August 2025 and sets minimum capital, reserve-backing, and redemption requirements for licensees.
formal_definition: Stablecoins Ordinance (Cap. 656), in force since 1 August 2025, establishing a licensing regime administered by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority for issuers of specified (fiat-referenced) stablecoins issued in Hong Kong or referencing the Hong Kong dollar.
